name: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company "Beema" (Q.P.S.C.)
summary: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company "Beema" (Q.P.S.C.) provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through Marine & Aviation; Motor; Fire & General Accidents; Takaful and Medical; and Investments. The company offers retail insurance products, such as motor, travel, home, domestic help accident, individual life, marine, and caravan insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products, including group medical health, group credit life, group life, aviation, marine hull, miscellaneous, engineering, liability, workmen's compensation, and property insurance. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lusail, Qatar.
